checks.name: The original catalog has unique stories, known topics and a real featured entry
Duplicate identities, impossible dates and excessive data are rejected
Search covers the full story text using normalized literal input
Unknown publication dates remain last in both date orders
Progressive pages cover the catalog once and terminate without a repeating cursor
Cursors cannot be reused for another query or catalog version
A failed next page can retry the same cursor without losing or duplicating records
Cancellation and disposal release active requests while another adapter stays usable
URL state preserves query, ordering, expanded position and article identity
Pagination is not hard-coded to the twelve-story demonstration
An unknown topic is an empty query, not a successful replacement for a request failure
Validation copies the catalog rather than retaining mutable source arrays

scope: Original local catalog, paging, query and cancellation invariants; not a source-site API or full large-catalog performance acceptance
